title: Intro to Onshape
line: Model two parts in the browser and join them in an assembly.

project.title: A hinge that opens and closes
project.brief: Design a two-leaf hinge alone in one Part Studio. Give each leaf screw holes and rounded corners, join the leaves with a Revolute mate in an assembly and export one leaf as an STL.
checks: The Part Studio has two parts and every sketch is fully defined
A Revolute mate joins the two leaves in an assembly
An STL of one leaf is exported

lessons.title: Make a document and look around
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner Onshape. Create a document named Wheel stand, set the units to millimeters, find the Part Studio and Assembly tabs and the Feature list, and rename the Part Studio to Parts.
lessons.passes: A document named Wheel stand has a Part Studio tab named Parts set to millimeters.

lessons.title: Sketch the bracket outline
lessons.goal: Teach sketching in an Onshape Part Studio by starting a sketch on the Front plane and drawing the U-shaped outline of a bracket with the Line tool, ending where it began.
lessons.passes: A sketch on the Front plane holds one closed U-shaped outline.

lessons.title: Dimension and constrain the sketch
lessons.goal: Teach Onshape dimensions and constraints by making the bracket outline 40 mm wide and 50 mm tall with 5 mm walls, using Equal and Symmetric until the sketch turns black.
lessons.passes: The sketch is fully defined, 40 mm wide and 50 mm tall with 5 mm walls.

lessons.title: Extrude the bracket
lessons.goal: Teach the Extrude tool in Onshape by turning the U-shaped sketch into a solid 20 mm deep and renaming the new part to Bracket in the parts list.
lessons.passes: The Part Studio has one part named Bracket that is 20 mm deep.

lessons.title: Cut the axle holes
lessons.goal: Teach sketching on a face and Extrude with Remove in Onshape by drawing a 6 mm circle 35 mm up one arm of the Bracket and cutting it through both arms.
lessons.passes: A 6 mm hole goes through both arms of the Bracket, 35 mm above its base.

lessons.title: Round the edges with Fillet
lessons.goal: Teach the Fillet tool in Onshape by rounding the outer corners of the Bracket with a 3 mm radius and finding the new feature in the Feature list.
lessons.passes: At least four edges of the Bracket carry a 3 mm fillet.

lessons.title: Add the wheel as a second part
lessons.goal: Teach making a second part in one Onshape Part Studio by sketching a 40 mm circle with a 6 mm hole and extruding it 20 mm as a new part named Wheel, centered between the arms.
lessons.passes: The Part Studio has two parts, Bracket and Wheel, and they do not overlap.

lessons.title: Put the parts in an assembly
lessons.goal: Teach Onshape assemblies by inserting the Bracket and the Wheel into the Assembly tab and using Fix to hold the Bracket still.
lessons.passes: The assembly holds one Bracket, fixed in place, and one Wheel.

lessons.title: Join them with a Revolute mate
lessons.goal: Teach Onshape mates and mate connectors by joining the hole in the Wheel to the hole in the Bracket with a Revolute mate, then dragging the Wheel to see it spin.
lessons.passes: A Revolute mate joins the Wheel to the Bracket and the Wheel can only spin.

lessons.title: Save a version and export an STL
lessons.goal: Teach Onshape versions and export by saving a version named V1 of the Wheel stand document and exporting the Wheel as an STL file to the Mac.
lessons.passes: The document has a version named V1 and an STL of the Wheel is downloaded.
